audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side is templated "Skill" on all 7 rows, contradicting content win[] (Brand favored all 7 stages) and matching the packet's own flagged defect (chart gives Brand 7/7 vs 0).
audit.why: Brand's kit is entirely ranged (Sear 1050 range, Pillar 900, Conflagration 625) against Poppy's melee frame with no ranged poke answer, so he wins every stage of lane on the numbers.
audit.corrected: Side set to Brand for all 7 rows, why rewritten to reflect the poke mismatch at each stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers, just generic filler text.
audit.why: Sear's cooldown (8/7.5/7/6.5/6s) and the condition for its stun (target must already be ablaze) are the concrete facts a player needs to time an approach.
audit.corrected: Added Sear's per-rank cooldown and the ablaze-stun condition, plus Pyroclasm's cooldown and its interrupt threat to Poppy's R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing-interactions data flags that Brand can cancel Poppy's Keeper's Verdict (R) channel with Sear (Q), and this was unmentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Keeper's Verdict is an interruptible channel — any CC cancels it — and Sear's stun is exactly that CC, so casting R while Sear is up is a wasted 100+s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Added to breakdown.cooldowns: only channel R once Brand's Sear is spent.
